action: Implement CloudIdentity Tenant member, invitation and role governance

verification.fullLocalGate: npm run verify:local:full passed: source tests, Console browser suite, TypeScript typecheck/lint/build, every Cloud Go module compile, the database-free owner suites, and every PostgreSQL owner suite with zero skips plus Docker integration.
focusedChecks: services/gateway-integration go test ./... passed against real PostgreSQL, including TestMemberGovernancePostgres and TestLastOwnerProtectionUnderConcurrencyPostgres
apps/console-bff go test ./... passed, including the write-guard, caller-propagation, 204 and owner-refusal member cases
packages/contracts/go go test ./... passed with the new typed error-code detail
go vet ./... passed for every Cloud Go module, and -tags=livebuild ./... for services/build
governedCases: cross-Tenant invitation revoke and member removal are refused; a foreign object is reported as absent, not as forbidden
member removal revokes the member's live sessions and its later Tenant read is unauthenticated or denied
the last owner can neither be demoted nor removed, under a locked Tenant row
two concurrent owner removals serialize: exactly one succeeds and one is refused with LAST_OWNER, leaving one active owner
inviteMember replay returns the original invitation; a consumed invitation cannot be accepted or revoked twice
acceptance advances Tenant permission_version and binds the invitee's own session to the Tenant
every governance decision writes an immutable audit row, including refused outcomes
no browser cookie, password, Gateway token or raw invitation token is persisted; invitations store only a token hash

limitations: Member.displayName is not yet resolved. The canonical field map sources it from gateway.identity_mappings through an authorised Gateway identity read, which the Gateway Integration identity-directory work package owns; the field is therefore currently emitted empty.
The remaining W03/W21 scope is unchanged: Tenant onboarding, suspend/reenable, delete/restore, retained-identity migration and Gateway wallet binding are separate outcomes.
The invitation validity window is a CloudIdentity owner constant (seven days); the canonical contract fixes only the expiresAt field, not the window.
External Sub2API authentication and the known test Tenant/member records remain declared local isolation prerequisites. No Cloud session, member or invitation decision is mocked.
No production deployment, Candidate or Release publication, Instance qualification, or real account/wallet mutation.
remainingBoundary: The browser member page in the retained Console shell is not part of this slice; the BFF REST surface for the implemented operations is. Gateway identity-directory display-name resolution stays with the Gateway Integration identity work package.
